title: CSCI 599 — Computer Science Undergraduate Independent Study
subject: Computing Practice and Research
description: An independent, catalog-aligned learning companion. It is not an official RIT course section or a replacement for the instructor's syllabus.
outcomes: Define the core components of a CSCI-599 proposal, including scope, deliverables, evaluation criteria, and credit allocation.
Explain the sequential workflow from proposal drafting to final report submission and grade proposal.
Identify the ethical and professional standards required for independent research and entrepreneurial or technical projects.
